principle: Prefer listMountedTools() over a dedicated unmountAllNonRuntimeTools() as the engine primitive — it's more broadly reusable. Unmount-all logic belongs in the caller (e.g. the persona plugin), which iterates listMountedTools() and filters runtime__* tools itself.

Tool-level autoMount on DroneToolDefinition is intentionally NOT introduced now; the "none" persona's automount list is just the runtime__* meta-tools. Revisit "other auto-mount tools merge into the persona automount list" if autoMount is ever added.
